features: 发音提示(连读/同化/浊化)

learnedSentences.text: Where is the nearest subway station?
variants: 更口语，metro 在欧陆常用
scenes: 对方指路或说 Go straight and turn left.
Can you pin the station on my map?
Is it the tube or the metro here?
英式 tube / 美式 subway / 欧陆 metro
learnedSentences.grammar: nearest 是 near 的最高级，the nearest + 名词 = 最近的…。subway（美）/ underground（英）/ metro（欧陆）同义，到当地用当地词更地道。
learnedSentences.pron: 连读：Where is→/wɛə rɪz/（r 连读）；is the→/ɪ zðə/（z 与 ð 连读）；the nearest 元音顺接。浊化：无典型。

learnedSentences.text: Could you say that again, please?
variants: 很随意，仅限熟人，慎对长辈/客户
scenes: 比 say again 更职业
Sorry, I didn't catch that. / You're breaking up.
learnedSentences.grammar: Could you + 动词原形 比 Can you 更礼貌（could 表委婉，不是过去式）。say 过去式是 said，但 say that again 用原形；again 重音在第二音节 /əˈɡɛn/。
learnedSentences.pron: 连读/同化：Could you→/kʊdʒu/（d+j 同化为 dʒ，关键！）；that again→/ðæ təˈɡɛn/（t 与 a 连读）。浊化：that again 快读 t→d：/ðæ dəˈɡɛn/。

learnedSentences.text: I'd like to book a table for two.
learnedSentences.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈteɪbəl fɔr tu/
learnedSentences.tip: book 在餐厅语境里是「预订」
variants: I'd like to reserve a table for two.
scenes: I'd like to book a table for two at 7.
加时间；对方回 Sure, window or inside?
Do you have a table for two?
对方回 It's fully booked.(满座) / Your name, please?
Can we put our name down?
learnedSentences.grammar: I'd like to… = I would like to…，比 I want 礼貌，点单/预订万能句。book/reserve 在餐厅酒店都表预订；for two 表两人份。
learnedSentences.pron: 连读：like to→/laɪk tə/（可连成 /laɪktə/）；book a→/bʊ kə/（k 与 a 连读）；table for→/ˈteɪbə wɔr/（l 后加 w 滑音）。浊化：like to 快读 t→d：/laɪ də/。

scenes: 对方回 Nice to meet you too.
This is my friend Tom. — Nice to meet you, Tom.
learnedSentences.grammar: It's + adj. + to do 是形式主语结构；meet 过去式 met，但寒暄用原形 meet。回句固定加 too（也很高兴认识你）。
learnedSentences.pron: 连读：It's nice→/ɪ tsnaɪs/（ts 连读）；nice to→/naɪs tə/（s 与 t 连读）；to meet→/tə wmiːt/（加 w 滑音）；meet you→/miː tʃu/（t+j 同化为 tʃ，关键！）。浊化：无典型。

scenes: 对方报价，可接 That's a bit much.(有点贵)
learnedSentences.grammar: How much + do/does + 主语 + cost? cost 此处作动词花费；this 单数用 does。口语更常省去 cost 直接说 How much is this?
learnedSentences.pron: 连读：How much→/haʊ mʌtʃ/（w 与 m 连读）；much does→/mʌtʃ dʌz/（tʃ 与 d）；does this→/dʌz ðɪs/（z 与 ð）。浊化：this cost 中 s 后接清 k，保持清音。

learnedSentences.text: What do you usually do on weekends?
learnedSentences.phonetic: /wʌt du ju ˈjuːʒuəli du ɑːn ˈwiːkendz/
variants: What do you do on weekends?
问周末有安排吗，更闲聊
How do you usually spend your weekends?
scenes: What do you usually do on weekends?
对方答 I usually… / Not much.
Do you wanna hang out this weekend?
I just chill at home. / I go hiking. / Work, unfortunately.
宅 / 徒步 / 无奈要加班
learnedSentences.grammar: 一般现在时表习惯；usually 放主语和动词之间（do you usually do）。周末：on weekends（美）/ at weekends（英）。
learnedSentences.pron: 连读：do you→/dʒu/（d+j 同化为 dʒ，关键！）；do on→/dʊ wɑn/（加 w 滑音）。浊化：What do→/wʌ dʊ/（t→d 浊化，极典型）；usually do 顺接。

learnedSentences.text: Is breakfast included in the price?
learnedSentences.tip: 订酒店一定要问的一句
variants: 最简，但不如 included 准确
scenes: 对方回 Yes, it's a buffet. / No, it's extra.(另收费) / Continental breakfast only.(仅欧式简早)
Does it include tax and service?
learnedSentences.grammar: be included in + 名词 是被动结构，表被包含在…里；price 单数用 is。included /ɪnˈkluːdɪd/ 是 include 的过去分词作形容词。
learnedSentences.pron: 连读：Is breakfast→/ɪz ˈbrekfəst/（z 与 b）；breakfast included→/ˈbrekfəst ɪnˈkluːdɪd/（t 与 ɪ）；included in→/ɪnˈkluːdɪd ɪn/（d 与 ɪ）。浊化：breakfast 词尾 t 在 ɪ 前快读可浊化为 d。

learnedSentences.text: Could you recommend a good local restaurant that's not too expensive and within walking distance?
learnedSentences.phonetic: /kʊd ju ˌrekəˈmend ə ɡʊd ˈloʊkəl ˈrestərənt ðæts nɑːt tuː ɪkˈspensɪv ənd ˈwɪðɪn ˈwɔːkɪŋ ˈdɪstəns/
learnedSentences.trans: 你能推荐一家不太贵、步行就能到的本地好餐厅吗？
learnedSentences.tip: 一句话把本地/便宜/近三个需求说清
variants: Any good local spots around here?
问本地人去哪吃，更地道
scenes: Can you recommend a good restaurant nearby?
Where's a nice place to eat around here?
Try the place on 5th St. / It's a bit touristy.(偏游客) / Book ahead, it's popular.(要预定)
learnedSentences.grammar: recommend 后接名词或动名词：recommend a restaurant / recommend going there。within walking distance 固定搭配步行范围内；that's = that is 引导从句。
learnedSentences.pron: 连读：Could you→/kʊdʒu/（d+j→dʒ）；good local→/ɡʊ wˈloʊkəl/（d 后加 w）；that's not→/ðæts nɑt/（s 与 n）；not too→/nɑ tʊ/（两个 t 只读一次）；too expensive 连读。浊化：not too 快读 /nɑ dʊ/（t→d）。

learnedSentences.text: I was wondering if you'd like to grab a coffee with me sometime this week.
learnedSentences.phonetic: /aɪ wʌz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf juːd laɪk tə ɡræb ə ˈkɔːfi wɪð miː ˈsʌmtaɪm ðɪs wiːk/
learnedSentences.trans: 我想问你这周有没有空跟我喝杯咖啡。
learnedSentences.tip: I was wondering if... 委婉邀约神句
variants: Want to get a coffee sometime?
scenes: I was wondering if you'd like to…
drink 可含咖啡/酒，看语境
Sure, Tuesday works. / I'd love to but I'm swamped.(想去但忙) / Rain check?(改天)
learnedSentences.grammar: I was wondering if… 用过去进行表委婉，比 Do you want 客气得多，邀约神句。would like to = 想（礼貌）；grab 本义抓，口语常指快速喝/吃。
learnedSentences.pron: 连读：was wondering→/wʌz ˈwʌndərɪŋ/（z 与 w）；grab a→/ɡræb ə/（b 与 a）；coffee with→/ˈkɔfi wɪð/（i 与 w）；sometime this→/ˈsʌmtaɪm ðɪs/（m 与 ð）。浊化：like to→/laɪ də/（t→d，同 wanna 规律）。

learnedSentences.text: I seem to have lost my way — could you tell me how to get to the city center from here?
learnedSentences.phonetic: /aɪ siːm tə hæv lɔst maɪ weɪ kʊd ju tel miː haʊ tə ɡet tə ðə ˈsɪti ˈsentər frəm hɪr/
learnedSentences.trans: 我好像迷路了，你能告诉我从这里怎么去市中心吗？
learnedSentences.tip: lost my way 迷路；city center 市中心
scenes: Excuse me, I seem to have lost my way.
对方指路或 Follow me.(跟我来)
Can you help me find this on Maps?
Go back to the main road. / I'll walk you there. / You're going the wrong way.(你走反了)
learnedSentences.grammar: I seem to have + 过去分词 表我好像（已经）…了，比 I'm lost 委婉。lost my way 固定搭配迷路；city center（英）/ downtown（美）都表市中心。
learnedSentences.pron: 连读：seem to→/siːm p tə/（m 后加 p 滑音）；lost my→/lɔs maɪ/（t 与 m）；my way→/maɪ weɪ/（aɪ 与 w）；could you→/kʊdʒu/；from here→/frəm hɪr/。浊化：lost my→/lɔz maɪ/ 或 /lɔd maɪ/（t→d，典型）；have 的 v 保持浊。
